nodes.label: save-assets

nodes.label: press-key

nodes.label: create-element
nodes.title: Create element

nodes.label: take-screenshot
nodes.title: Take screenshot

nodes.label: download-file

nodes.label: export-data

nodes.label: get-tab-url

nodes.label: delay

nodes.label: ai-text-generation

nodes.description: Drop in a prompt, pull context from files or the web, pick your model, and let it draft the text you need.

nodes.label: extract-data

nodes.description: Point it at a page, pick your model, and pull out any fields you want—names, dates, images, whatever—cleanly structured from messy content.

nodes.label: image-generation

nodes.label: sentiment-analysis

nodes.description: Check the vibe of a message, post, or even a screenshot—spot whether it’s positive, negative, or neutral so you can respond the right way.

nodes.label: visual-analysis
nodes.title: Visual analysis
nodes.description: Let the model “look” at a page or image and tell you what’s there—objects, text, layout, what stands out, and what might need attention.

nodes.label: switch-tab

nodes.label: go-back
nodes.title: Go back
nodes.description: Step back in history when you need to retry or collect more data.

nodes.label: go-forward
nodes.title: Go forward
nodes.description: Move forward again after a branch or validation step.

nodes.label: clipboard
nodes.title: Clipboard
nodes.description: Read from or write to the clipboard to pass quick snippets.

nodes.label: reload-tab
nodes.title: Reload tab
nodes.description: Refresh the current tab to reset state or pull fresh content.

nodes.label: active-tab
nodes.title: Active tab
nodes.description: Lock actions to the current active tab so you stay in context.

nodes.label: close-tab
nodes.title: Close tab
nodes.description: Close tabs by index or pattern to keep sessions tidy.

nodes.label: conditions
nodes.title: Conditions
nodes.description: Route the flow with if/else and AND/OR logic—or even AI checks on text/sentiment—to decide what happens next.

nodes.label: repeat-task

nodes.label: slice-variable

nodes.label: increase-variable

nodes.label: regex-variable
nodes.title: Regex variable

nodes.label: sort-data
nodes.title: Sort data
